snippet.title: Under Fire! gameplay (PC Game, 1985)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Under Fire!, Dos PC game produced by Avalon Hill in 1985 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/under-fire/4427/
Under Fire is a tactical simulation of World War II combat. Under Fire can be played by one or two players. There are nine scenarios in the game.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.

Similar videos you may like:
